title: Playoffs follow-ups: Back replaces history, docs wording and totals
request: Follow-up to the Back to brackets task. Doug said yes to: (1) use replace instead of push when a bracket is closed, so the phone Back button does not re-open it; (4) fix the small docs wording nits and the stale checklist totals in verification/README.md.

criteria.text: Closing a bracket uses a history REPLACE, not a push, on every route that closes one (the Back to brackets button, the error banner button, and deleting a bracket). Opening a bracket still pushes. A hook test for each is written first (RED, then GREEN).
criteria.evidence: usePlayoffPageData.ts closing branch now calls setSelectedBracketId close as setSearchParams(params, { replace: true }); opening still pushes (diff of 46d9090 read by me). The reviewer grepped every caller: Back to brackets button (PlayoffView, AdminView), the error banner button and delete (AdminView and the hook). Tests first: tests-RED.txt shows 2 failed (close and delete) and 11 passed; tests-GREEN.txt shows 14 files and 73 tests passing (builder). I re-ran the hooks and views folders myself: 13 files, 70 tests pass.

criteria.text: Real browser proof of the history stack with the fake data (390 px, touch): open the list, open a bracket, press Back to brackets, then press the browser Back. Report the URL after each step. Also the direct-link case (open /playoffs?bracket=<id> first). Report the real behaviour honestly, including any extra Back step.
criteria.evidence: Real browser history proof (history-before.txt, history-after.txt, history-extra.txt; I read the raw log). Before the change Back re-opened the closed bracket in all three sequences (A 3 presses to leave, B 2, C 3). After: A (list, open, Back to brackets): Back press 1 is a dead step with no visible change, press 2 leaves (2 presses). B (direct link): leaves at once (1 press). C (failed bracket, banner button): a dead step, then leaves (2 presses). Run by me: D (two open and close cycles): 3 presses to leave, 2 of them dead, so dead steps stack. E (change the season while a bracket is open): Back brings the bracket back, because the season route still pushes.

criteria.text: Docs follow the code: the cache time limit (a bracket stays cached 5 minutes after its last use), the scroll sentence, the pill wording in the Playoffs page row and in checklist rows PLAYOFF-25 and PLAYOFF-29 (a dot on a phone), the Loading bracket banner wording, one line in read-a-bracket.md about the new spinner, and the history behaviour (state diagram, Cancel and interrupt rows, a checklist row). Every sentence checked against the code.
criteria.evidence: Docs follow the code. Commits 931801e, 633fb57 and 4ff85a8: the cache time limit (gcTime is 5 minutes, useBracketData.ts line 206), the scroll sentence, a dot on a phone in the Network lost row, the open question and rows PLAYOFF-25 and PLAYOFF-29, the Loading bracket banner wording, one line in read-a-bracket.md about the new spinner, and the history behaviour (paragraph, browser Back row, new rows PLAYOFF-43, 44 and 45). The review found two overstatements (never, and stacking) and short footers; I fixed them and checked both in a browser. Re-review APPROVE.

criteria.text: The totals in docs/product-description/verification/README.md are recounted with a script and match the checklist files. The counting method is stated in the commit.
criteria.evidence: Totals recounted by script (python3 -I; rows whose first cell is an ID such as ROUND-12 or STAND-11a and whose second cell is a priority): 1,958 items, admin.md 386, 117 P1 rows marked (suspected bug), 70 admin rows marked (destructive), no duplicate IDs, every row has 8 columns. Written in verification/README.md with the method and in docs/product-description/README.md. My first recount missed 18 lettered IDs; the review caught it and the reviewer recounted with its own script to the same numbers. Commits bcfe095 and 824a8d4.

criteria.text: Two code comments are corrected to match the code: SeasonSelector.tsx (it says the component is mounted twice; check what is true) and PlayoffView.tsx (the Loading bracket banner is the only banner with a Back button).
criteria.evidence: c95cd2b is comments only (I read every changed line; no non-comment line changed). SeasonSelector.tsx now says useId gives each copy its own id (the component is mounted once, PlayoffPageLayout.tsx line 81). PlayoffView.tsx and AdminView.tsx comments say only the Loading bracket banner has its own Back to brackets.

criteria.text: Nothing else changes: existing playoff tests pass, no test is skipped or weakened, and the real tap test still works (open a bracket, press Back to brackets, the list shows, the address loses bracket=).
criteria.evidence: Existing tests pass and nothing is skipped or weakened: no skip, only, todo, ts-expect-error or eslint-disable added (grep on the diff). The unit suite passes on 824a8d4. The tap test still works: the history script taps Back to brackets in every run and the list shows with bracket= gone from the address (history-after.txt steps A2, B1, C3).

criteria.text: All required repo checks pass on the final commit and a fresh independent reviewer approves it. Left alone and reported.
criteria.evidence: All six required checks pass on 824a8d4: integrity, typecheck, lint (112 s), knip, build, unit (602 s). A fresh independent reviewer first said CHANGES (docs only), both findings fixed, re-review APPROVE. Left alone and reported: the dead Back press the replace change leaves (it stacks per open and close; option: go back one real step when the reader came from the list), the season-in-the-address contradictions in older docs (the-playoffs-page.md lines 123-126, 141-143, 219-221 and standings.md rows PLAYOFF-11 and PLAYOFF-13), one optional wording nit on the progress-bar sentence, and the delete flow was not run in a browser (the fake data has no delete route; the unit test covers it).
